survey: A cartoon flying saucer, seen from a three-quarter view above and to the front, tilted so its right side is higher. Main parts: (1) A wide brushed-metal saucer body whose top slopes up in a shallow cone toward the center. (2) A green glass dome near the center, sitting in a raised metal collar ring. The ring is drawn at the same viewing angle as the saucer, so the dome sits on the hull and does not float. (3) A thick dark-metal bumper ring around the saucer's outer edge. (4) Orange light studs set into that bumper at roughly even spacing. The studs on the far side are hidden behind the dome where you would expect, and the studs at the near edge get bigger with perspective. The saucer floats with no support, which is correct for a flying craft. The underside is out of view. The shapes are round and match on both sides, and no parts pass through each other.
